product_overview: API REST para el Portal de Clientes ECLARITI, orientada a la administración de empresas, centros de costo, proyectos, activos, actividades, solicitudes y documentos. Provee autenticación JWT, control de permisos por rol y empresa, almacenamiento de archivos en S3 y notificaciones por correo para eventos y recordatorios.
core_goals: Autenticar usuarios y autorizar acceso según rol, empresa y permisos específicos.
Gestionar entidades jerárquicas del portal: empresas, centros de costo, proyectos, activos y actividades.
Administrar usuarios, permisos, noticias y catálogos maestros para operación del portal.
Permitir carga, descarga, vencimiento y eliminación de documentos asociados a distintas entidades.
Soportar solicitudes documentales y el seguimiento de su estado, adjuntos y revisión.
Exponer tareas programadas para recordatorios de vencimiento de proyectos y actividades.

features.name: Autenticacion
features.description: Permite iniciar sesión con email y contraseña para obtener un JWT con rol y cliente_id, habilitando el acceso al resto de la API.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/auth/login with valid email and password -> Receive 200 with access_token and usuario data -> Use JWT in subsequent authenticated requests -> Receive authorized access to protected endpoints
POST /api/v1/auth/login with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 Credenciales invalidas -> No access_token is issued -> Protected endpoints remain inaccessible

features.name: Empresas (Clientes)
features.description: Gestiona empresas cliente, incluyendo su creación, consulta, actualización, logo, documentos y eliminación.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/auth/login with admin credentials -> Receive 200 with access_token -> POST /api/v1/empresas with valid company payload and JWT -> Receive 201 or 200 with empresa creada -> GET /api/v1/empresas/:id with JWT -> Receive 200 with empresa detalle -> POST /api/v1/empresas/:id/logo with image file -> Receive 200 with logo actualizado

POST /api/v1/auth/login with non-authorized credentials -> Receive 200 with access_token -> DELETE /api/v1/empresas/:id with JWT when user is not super_admin -> Receive 403 forbidden or equivalent authorization error -> Company is not deleted

GET /api/v1/empresas/:id/logo without JWT -> Receive 200 with public logo file if it exists -> GET /api/v1/empresas/:id/documentos without JWT -> Receive 401 unauthorized -> Protected company documents are not accessible

features.name: Centros de costo
features.description: Administra centros de costo dentro de una empresa y sus documentos, con validación de acceso por empresa.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/auth/login with authorized company user -> Receive 200 with access_token -> POST /api/v1/empresas/:empresaId/centros with valid data -> Receive 201 or 200 with centro created -> GET /api/v1/empresas/:empresaId/centros -> Receive 200 with lista de centros -> POST /api/v1/empresas/:empresaId/centros/:centroId/documentos with file -> Receive 200 with documento subido

POST /api/v1/auth/login with user from another empresa -> Receive 200 with access_token -> GET /api/v1/empresas/:empresaId/centros/:centroId with JWT -> Receive 403 access denied by EmpresaAccessGuard or equivalent -> Centro details are not returned

POST /api/v1/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with access_token -> GET /api/v1/centros-costos/:id for a non-existent center -> Receive 404 NotFoundException -> No center data is returned

features.name: Proyectos
features.description: Permite crear, consultar, actualizar y eliminar proyectos dentro de un centro de costo, además de administrar sus documentos y catálogos de tipos de proyecto.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/auth/login with authorized user -> Receive 200 with access_token -> POST /api/v1/empresas/:empresaId/centros/:centroId/proyectos with valid payload -> Receive 201 or 200 with proyecto creado -> GET /api/v1/empresas/:empresaId/centros/:centroId/proyectos -> Receive 200 with proyectos del centro -> POST /api/v1/empresas/:empresaId/centros/:centroId/proyectos/:proyectoId/documentos with file -> Receive 200 with documento subido

POST /api/v1/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with access_token -> PUT /api/v1/empresas/:empresaId/centros/:centroId/proyectos/:proyectoId with invalid or mismatched ids -> Receive 404 or 403 depending on validation and access rules -> Proyecto is not updated

POST /api/v1/auth/login with authorized credentials -> Receive 200 with access_token -> GET /api/v1/tipos-proyecto -> Receive 200 with tipos de proyecto -> POST /api/v1/tipos-proyecto with non-super_admin role -> Receive 403 forbidden -> Type is not created

features.name: Usuarios
features.description: Gestiona usuarios internos y consumidores, cambio de contraseña y suscripciones de notificaciones para administradores.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/auth/login with admin credentials -> Receive 200 with access_token -> POST /api/v1/usuarios with valid user data -> Receive 201 or 200 with usuario created -> GET /api/v1/usuarios/:id -> Receive 200 with usuario detalle -> PATCH /api/v1/usuarios/:id/password with new password -> Receive 200 with password updated

POST /api/v1/auth/login with user attempting to update another user's password without permission -> Receive 200 with access_token -> PATCH /api/v1/usuarios/:id/password with unauthorized context -> Receive 403 forbidden or equivalent access error -> Password is not changed

POST /api/v1/auth/login with admin credentials -> Receive 200 with access_token -> PATCH /api/v1/usuarios/:id/suscripciones for a non-admin or non-self user -> Receive 403 forbidden -> Notification subscriptions are not updated

features.name: Activos
features.description: Administra activos físicos asociados a centros de costo, incluyendo documentos, historial y catálogos de tipos de activo.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/auth/login with authorized user -> Receive 200 with access_token -> POST /api/v1/empresas/:empresaId/centros/:centroId/activos with valid payload -> Receive 201 or 200 with activo creado -> GET /api/v1/empresas/:empresaId/centros/:centroId/activos/:activoId/historial -> Receive 200 with historial del activo -> POST /api/v1/empresas/:empresaId/centros/:centroId/activos/:activoId/documentos with file -> Receive 200 with documento subido
POST /api/v1/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with access_token -> GET /api/v1/activos/:id for a missing asset -> Receive 404 NotFoundException -> No asset detail is returned
POST /api/v1/auth/login with non-super_admin role -> Receive 200 with access_token -> POST /api/v1/tipos-activo with valid payload -> Receive 403 forbidden -> Asset type is not created

features.name: Actividades
features.description: Permite administrar actividades por centro de costo, con documentos, tipos de actividad y visibilidad por empresa o administración global.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/auth/login with authorized user -> Receive 200 with access_token -> POST /api/v1/empresas/:empresaId/centros/:centroId/actividades with valid payload -> Receive 201 or 200 with actividad creada -> GET /api/v1/empresas/:empresaId/centros/:centroId/actividades -> Receive 200 with actividades del centro -> POST /api/v1/empresas/:empresaId/centros/:centroId/actividades/:actividadId/documentos with file -> Receive 200 with documento subido

POST /api/v1/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with access_token -> DELETE /api/v1/empresas/:empresaId/centros/:centroId/actividades/:actividadId with invalid access or missing resource -> Receive 403 or 404 -> Activity is not deleted
POST /api/v1/auth/login with non-super_admin role -> Receive 200 with access_token -> POST /api/v1/tipos-actividad with valid payload -> Receive 403 forbidden -> Activity type is not created

features.name: Solicitudes
features.description: Gestiona solicitudes de documentos por empresa, incluyendo su creación, edición, cambio de estado y adjuntos.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/auth/login with authorized user -> Receive 200 with access_token -> POST /api/v1/empresas/:empresaId/solicitudes with valid payload -> Receive 201 or 200 with solicitud creada -> GET /api/v1/empresas/:empresaId/solicitudes -> Receive 200 with lista de solicitudes -> PUT /api/v1/empresas/:empresaId/solicitudes/:solicitudId/estado to revision or aprobado -> Receive 200 with estado actualizado -> GET /api/v1/empresas/:empresaId/solicitudes/:solicitudId/adjunto after upload -> Receive 200 with adjunto descargable

POST /api/v1/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with access_token -> POST /api/v1/empresas/:empresaId/solicitudes/:solicitudId/adjuntar when solicitud is in an invalid state -> Receive 400 or equivalent business rule error -> File is not attached
POST /api/v1/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with access_token -> GET /api/v1/solicitudes/en-revision as non-admin -> Receive 403 forbidden -> Revision queue is not returned

features.name: Documentos vencidos
features.description: Centraliza el listado y descarga de documentos marcados como vencidos para el usuario autenticado.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/auth/login with authorized user -> Receive 200 with access_token -> GET /api/v1/documentos-vencidos -> Receive 200 with documentos vencidos accesibles -> GET /api/v1/documentos-vencidos/:id -> Receive 200 with file content or download response

POST /api/v1/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with access_token -> GET /api/v1/documentos-vencidos/:id for an unknown document -> Receive 404 NotFoundException -> No document is downloaded

features.name: Noticias
features.description: Administra noticias del portal y su imagen asociada, con lectura pública de la imagen y escritura restringida a super_admin.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/auth/login with super_admin credentials -> Receive 200 with access_token -> POST /api/v1/noticias with valid content -> Receive 201 or 200 with noticia created -> POST /api/v1/noticias/:id/imagen with image file -> Receive 200 with imagen uploaded -> GET /api/v1/noticias/:id -> Receive 200 with noticia detalle
POST /api/v1/auth/login with non-super_admin role -> Receive 200 with access_token -> POST /api/v1/noticias with valid payload -> Receive 403 forbidden -> News item is not created
GET /api/v1/noticias/:id/imagen without JWT -> Receive 200 with public image if it exists -> DELETE /api/v1/noticias/:id without super_admin JWT -> Receive 403 forbidden -> News item is not deleted

features.name: Permisos
features.description: Asigna y revoca permisos de acceso de usuarios consumidores sobre centros de costo específicos.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/auth/login with admin credentials -> Receive 200 with access_token -> POST /api/v1/permisos with user and centro payload -> Receive 201 or 200 with permiso asignado -> GET /api/v1/permisos/usuario/:usuarioId -> Receive 200 with permisos del usuario -> GET /api/v1/permisos/centro/:centroId -> Receive 200 with permisos del centro

POST /api/v1/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with access_token -> DELETE /api/v1/permisos/usuario/:usuarioId/centro/:centroId for a permission that does not exist -> Receive 404 NotFoundException or equivalent -> No permission is revoked
POST /api/v1/auth/login with insufficient privileges -> Receive 200 with access_token -> POST /api/v1/permisos with unauthorized context -> Receive 403 forbidden -> Permission is not assigned

features.name: Tareas programadas (cron)
features.description: Expone endpoints públicos protegidos por un header de autorización propio para disparar recordatorios automáticos de vencimiento de proyectos y actividades.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/tareas/recordatorios-proyectos with valid CRON_SECRET authorization header -> Receive 200 after recordatorio job runs -> Notifications are sent for projects nearing due date -> POST /api/v1/tareas/recordatorios-actividades with valid CRON_SECRET authorization header -> Receive 200 after recordatorio job runs -> Notifications are sent for activities nearing due date
POST /api/v1/tareas/recordatorios-proyectos without the expected authorization header -> Receive 401 or 403 unauthorized -> Recordatorio job is not executed
POST /api/v1/tareas/recordatorios-actividades with invalid secret header -> Receive 401 or 403 unauthorized -> Activity reminder job is not executed
